title: Card flavour lines load beside the engine
notes: The cards' flavour lines and artist credits (flavour.json, about 98 KB raw) no longer ride the entry chunk: apps/web/src/cards/flavour.ts serves the sidecar through loadFlavour(), one shared dynamic import in a chunk beside the engine module that main.tsx starts at boot, and HoverPreview, Flavour, HeroInspect and NotFoundPlay's LostCard read it through useFlavour(), so a view opened early gains its line when the table lands. How cards look only: no card plays differently.

player.title: Card flavour lines load beside the engine
fixes: The home page no longer downloads every card's flavour line before it can start, so the first screen is ready sooner on slow connections.
